title: Marchland Oaths 1.6.0 seeded cycle evidence
scope: Fifty seeded mechanics cycles per locale, 28 steps each, with save/load identity assertions and Second Oath laps in 25 of the 50 seeds. These are seeded mechanics cycles, not fifty full campaign playthroughs. The two complete sixty-objective campaign routes are separate suite cases recorded in suites.json.
leak_policy: The seeded-fuzz case fails on any new assertion failure and on node growth across the run.
